prompts.material:
Use case: product-mockup.
Input image is a MATERIAL AND WEAR REFERENCE ONLY: the approved old straw sleeping mat, top view in upper portion. Create a production game BASE COLOR texture, not an object photograph.
Generate one flat, rectified rectangular swatch filling the entire image, landscape 2:1 aspect ratio. It represents 1.8 metres horizontally by 0.9 metres vertically of this exact sun-faded tan cattail/rice-straw plain weave. Match the reference's muted straw gold, pale dry fibre, dusty grey-brown broken straws and irregular low-contrast warm mud/water tide stains. Fine flattened grass strips with plain one-over/one-under weave, irregular handmade narrow strand widths, tiny fine longitudinal fibre grain. Approximately 140–180 visible warp/weft intersections across the 1.8m horizontal width; shallow weave, no basket blocks. Keep the entire swatch in focus.
Reproduce the REFERENCE'S broad wear distribution: smoky earthy fading at left margin and top-left corner, isolated pale scuffed spots through middle, a soft irregular water tide ring in the lower right quadrant, restrained muddy wear near right edge, a few fragmented straw tips and worn crossovers. Retain mostly usable straw surface, no huge holes.
The whole image is material from edge to edge: NO border rope, no outside background, no vignette, no shadows, no light gradient, no perspective, no curled edges, no multiple views or layout, no dimension marks. Completely diffuse flat scan / albedo color under uniform cross-polarized white illumination. Do not bake directional highlights or cavity black shadows into color. No text, no symbols, no labels, no watermark, no green cloth or modern material. Fine natural broken grass texture must be legible; plant fibre remains matte. This is an unlit material texture for the approved reference, not a redesign.
prompts.rope:
Use case: product-mockup.
Input image is MATERIAL REFERENCE ONLY: the two binding cords and carrying loop of the approved rolled straw mat. Create a production material swatch to wrap around a thin straw rope, not a render of an object.
One square swatch entirely filled edge-to-edge with golden tan and weathered grey-brown twisted natural STRAW FIBRES, matching the reference binding cord. Unwrapped cylindrical rope surface: parallel compact bundles crossing diagonally at a shallow 25–35 degree angle, consistent diagonal twist cadence, fine splintery lengthwise grass fibres and scattered wispy pale broken ends. No over-under basket weave here. Small variable dark grooves between twisted strands, without deep black shadows. Same natural dry straw color and old subdued wear as the reference, no glossy golden highlights.
Flat scan under uniform cross-polarized white light, an ALBEDO / BASE COLOR texture: no cast shadows, no lighting gradient, no depth-of-field, no vignette, no perspective. No silhouettes or rope boundaries; whole square is texture material. Do not draw a visible rope lying on a background, no knots, loops, bands or other objects, no text or watermarks, no synthetic or fabric fibres, no plastic, no metal. Natural realistic plant fibres only.
